assessment.nobel_worthiness: Inflation and quantum-seeded structure supply a remarkably powerful physical account of the observed large-scale universe.
assessment.attribution: Guth initiated inflation, while Starobinsky and Mukhanov made central theoretical contributions to its realizations and perturbation predictions.
assessment.maturity: Its principal predictions have been tested extensively through cosmological observations over decades.
uncertainties: The direct primordial gravitational-wave signature remains unobserved.
Several inflationary mechanisms and contributors complicate a uniquely bounded attribution.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Imaging the immediate environment of a black hole is an exceptional observational advance in gravitation and astronomy.
assessment.attribution: Falcke provided decisive early scientific vision for black-hole imaging and Doeleman led the VLBI effort that made it practical.
assessment.maturity: The result has been independently strengthened by images of two very different black-hole systems.
uncertainties: The accomplishment rests on a vast collaboration, making individual credit intrinsically difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: BAO transformed a fossil feature of the early universe into a precise geometrical probe of cosmic expansion.
assessment.attribution: Eisenstein, Colless, and Cole were central to establishing and measuring the standard-ruler method in galaxy surveys.
assessment.maturity: The technique is mature, repeatedly confirmed, and now central to precision cosmology.
uncertainties: The theoretical origin and observational development involved a broad community.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: WMAP made the cosmic microwave background a precision testbed for the physical parameters and history of the universe.
assessment.attribution: Bennett and Page led the experimental enterprise, while Spergel was central to extracting its cosmological implications.
assessment.maturity: Its measurements have endured comparison with later experiments and remain foundational.
uncertainties: The appropriate division of credit between WMAP and later CMB missions requires care.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The double pulsar furnished uniquely clean strong-field tests of general relativity in a natural laboratory.
assessment.attribution: Burgay's discovery and Kramer's leading timing and interpretation work form a coherent core of credit.
assessment.maturity: Long-baseline timing has produced increasingly stringent and durable tests.
uncertainties: Credit for the discovery and observational program extends beyond two individuals.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The neutron-star-merger kilonova connected gravitational-wave astronomy to the cosmic origin of heavy elements.
assessment.attribution: Metzger and Kasen supplied key predictive interpretation, and Tanvir was central to the observational identification.
assessment.maturity: The multimessenger event gave compelling evidence for the mechanism and initiated a vigorous observational field.
uncertainties: The relative contribution of mergers to the full r-process inventory remains under active study.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: High-energy neutrino astronomy opened a genuinely new observational channel onto violent cosmic accelerators.
assessment.attribution: Halzen and Spiering were long-standing scientific leaders in conceiving and realizing IceCube.
assessment.maturity: The diffuse flux and astrophysical associations have moved the field beyond a single anomalous observation.
uncertainties: The discovery and detector construction were deeply collective efforts.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Stable numerical-relativity simulations made quantitative binary-black-hole gravitational-wave astronomy possible.
assessment.attribution: Pretorius, Campanelli, and Baker were pivotal in resolving the longstanding merger-simulation problem.
assessment.maturity: The methods have been repeatedly validated against gravitational-wave observations and are indispensable to their interpretation.
uncertainties: Several near-simultaneous breakthroughs and earlier foundational developments complicate priority.
